item.title: Congo launches Ebola vaccination drive to tackle deadly outbreak
item.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo is launching an Ebola vaccination campaign to tackle the deadliest outbreak.

item.title: US nears deal to secure stake in Venezuelan oil fields, insiders say
item.description: Pact with Caracas would bolster US oil supplies for years to come, but may face legal challenges.

item.title: Fired Stars and Stripes journalists sue Trump administration for censorship
item.description: Staff at the military newspaper allege US government sought to violate First Amendment rights to free speech.

item.title: Anti-migrant protesters burn tents in Ceuta and block Red Cross aid
item.description: Anti-migrant protests have escalated in Spain’s Ceuta, with demonstrators dismantling and burning migrant shelters.

item.title: Federal US judge faces complaint over staunch pro-Israel advocacy
item.description: A lawyer has accused Judge Roy Altman, who calls the keffiyeh a 'terror scarf', of anti-Palestinian bias in his remarks.

item.title: Chad accuses Sudan of air strike near shared border that killed 12
item.description: An air strike on a fuel market near Chad's border with Sudan killed 12 and injured seven, according to officials.

item.title: Fmr US Diplomat: Netanyahu sees ‘political value’ in Turkiye as enemy
item.description: A former US diplomat says Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sees ‘political value’ in Turkiye as Israel’s latest enemy.

item.title: Iran says it will name its terms for reopening Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran to issue terms for reopening Strait of Hormuz as mediating countries send delegations to Tehran to revive talks.

item.title: Malaysia to return 1,500 Rohingya refugees next month, despite safety fears
item.description: First phase of Malaysia's repatriation plan will involve Myanmar nationals who are 'willing to return voluntarily'.

item.title: New Israeli roadblocks entrench siege of homes in West Bank’s Qusra
item.description: After weeks of settler siege, three new Israeli gates around Palestinian homes in Qusra raise fears in West Bank.

item.title: US aid cuts threaten Ghana’s child immunisation gains
item.description: Ghana faces a $78.2m health funding shortfall as aid cuts put immunisation gains at risk.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran prepares conditions to open Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran says it is preparing to draft conditions to open the Strait of Hormuz following mediator requests.

item.title: US charges 81 in Puerto Rico gang case, as Trump cartel crackdown continues
item.description: The arrests are part of a federal task force initiative targeting criminal gangs and transnational organisations.

item.title: US judge questions the push to add Trump’s name back to the Kennedy Center
item.description: Venue's board of directors, stacked with supporters of the president, voted to add his name again despite past ruling.

item.title: Syria’s president appoints ex-commander of Kurdish-led SDF as advisor
item.description: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa appoints Mazloum Abdi as presidential advisor, three days after dissolution of SDF.

item.title: Haiti police confront public frustration after deadly gang attack kills 47
item.description: The attack in Kenscoff, a community where crime had been declining, has raised questions about Haiti's security.

item.title: Bosnian Serb General Ratko Mladic has died
item.description: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Ratko Mladic dies

item.title: Barcelona scraps Spain World Cup tribute amid fans’ Catalan flag support
item.description: An act supporting Catalonia's pro-independence symbol organized as Barcelona hosts first game since Spain World Cup win.

item.title: Raphinha scores again as Barcelona ease past Athletic Club in La Liga
item.description: Raphinha nets his third goal in Barcelona's first two games of new season as Athletic Club beaten 2-0 in La Liga.

item.title: Crystal Palace vs Man City: Premier League – prediction, teams, lineups
item.description: Manchester City travels to Crystal Palace, looking to build on their late show in their opening Premier League match.

item.title: Canada welcomes US shift on French language discoverability in trade talks
item.description: US trade officials downplay French language dispute, calling claims fabricated.

item.title: Video: Trump signs order to re-name Lake Ontario as Lake America
item.description: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America.

item.title: US Postal Service says mail-in ballot restrictions now in effect
item.description: The US Supreme Court ruled in favor of changes backed by President Donald Trump, but new challenges have been filed.

item.title: ‘Everything is covered in ash’: Indonesia wildfires leave people in crisis
item.description: Fires severely impacting people's health in West Kalimantan, with pregnant women and children particularly vulnerable.

item.title: Belugas and dolphins rescued from Canada’s Marineland arrive in Spain
item.description: Two belugas and four dolphins from Canada’s Marineland were relocated to an aquarium in Spain.
